backend/main.mo: Main backend canister implementing server hosting platform with authorization, server plans, user profiles, orders, invoices, shopping carts, Stripe integration, dedicated server management, and admin invitation system.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features for admin dashboard, dedicated server management (create, assign, delete), and subscription plan management with associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and documentation covering the complete React application structure with admin setup, payment flows, and server management features.
frontend/ADMIN_SETUP_FAULT_LIST.md: Developer documentation listing three known admin setup faults (stale admin flag, inconsistent admin state, profile modal flashing) with symptoms, root causes, fixes, and debugging steps.
frontend/FRONTEND_FILE_TREE.md: Comprehensive developer reference documenting all frontend files and directories with descriptions, purposes, editability status, and special markers for admin setup flow components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and script tag for mounting the React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, plans, dashboard, admin, and payment status pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AdminInvitationM: Component for admins to generate and manage invitation codes that grant admin privileges to other users. Displays active invitation codes with copy functionality and creator information.
frontend/src/components/AdminSetupNotice: Alert component shown to authenticated non-admin users, offering them the ability to redeem an admin invitation code. Hidden for unauthenticated users and existing admins.
frontend/src/components/AssignServerDial: Dialog component that allows admins to assign a dedicated server either to a specific user or to a subscription plan. Includes radio group selection and dropdowns for users/plans.
frontend/src/components/CreateServerDial: Dialog form for creating new dedicated servers with fields for ID, name, CPU cores, RAM, and storage. Validates inputs and submits server creation request.
frontend/src/components/DeleteServerDial: Confirmation dialog for deleting a dedicated server with a warning if the server is currently assigned. Prevents accidental deletion with explicit user confirmation.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer component displaying copyright information and a link to caffeine.ai with a heart icon.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Main navigation header with authentication controls, responsive mobile menu, cart icon with item count badge, and conditional admin/redemption links based on user role.
frontend/src/components/InvitationCodeRe: Dialog component for redeeming admin invitation codes, handles code submission, error states, and navigates to admin page on success.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component that wraps the application with Header, Footer, AdminSetupNotice, and ProfileSetupModal, using Outlet for nested routes.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal that prompts authenticated users without a profile to enter their name and email, blocking interaction until profile is created.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetupModal: Dialog for configuring Stripe payment settings including secret key and allowed countries list.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control with admin token from URL params.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state and identity persistence using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for backend operations including server plans, user profiles, shopping cart, orders, invoices, admin functions, and Stripe configuration.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark theme colors using OKLCH color space and grid background pattern utility.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page for managing server plans, orders, users, dedicated servers, Stripe configuration, and admin invitations. Provides CRUD operations for server plans and displays tables for orders, users, and servers with assignment/deletion capabilities.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: User dashboard page displaying cart items, orders, and invoices with checkout functionality via Stripe. Includes invitation code redemption feature for non-admin users to gain admin privileges.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section showcasing dedicated server offerings and a features section highlighting benefits like full root access, high performance, security, and 24/7 support. Includes navigation to plans and dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Payment failure page displayed when Stripe checkout fails, showing error message and providing navigation options to return to cart or browse plans.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Payment success page displayed after successful Stripe checkout, clears the cart on mount and provides navigation to dashboard or plans with confirmation message.
frontend/src/pages/PlansPage.tsx: Server plans browsing page displaying available predefined server plans and a custom server configuration builder. Allows users to add plans or custom configurations to cart with dynamic pricing calculation.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and functions to clear sensitive parameters from URLs.
frontend/STRIPE_CONFIGURATION.md: Guide for configuring Stripe API keys explaining the admin UI method for setting secret keys and allowed countries via the StripeSetupModal component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, animations for accordions, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing a server hosting admin platform with Motoko backend, React frontend, Internet Identity authentication, Stripe payment integration, and comprehensive CRUD operations for servers and subscription plans.
